messages:
sarah (PM): FYI — competitor just announced a hosted feature that mirrors our per-route SLO controls. Saw it in the demo, looks like a quick toggle + UI. :eyes:

elaine (Sales): whoa. Which customers are asking for our per-route SLO UX? this could shift deals in pipeline.

oliver (CS): acme pilot specifically asked for easier per-route overrides last week. Support threads show people copy config between routes now.

mohit (Product Ops): quick ask: can we surface a minimal parity path that doesn't require infra changes? e.g., a UI toggle + routing policy shim?

alex (Eng): technically we have most of the pieces: routing policies, fallback variants. The risky bit is the policy UI + validation and telemetry. Backend estimate: 3 sprints to build safe UI-driven rollout + audits.

nate (Design): we could prototype a simple toggle and a JSON advanced mode. Low fidelity: 2 design days, then handoff. UX should highlight cost/latency tradeoffs per route.

kim (Data): need to ensure telemetry surfaced: per-route token consumption + 95% latency so PMs can make tradeoffs. I can wire dashboards if we can emit route tags.

sarah (PM): proposal: triage into two tracks—(A) parity-lite: UI toggle + policy shim + per-route telemetry (shipable fast); (B) differentiator-fwd: richer routing controls + recommendation engine for cost/quality. Recommend we push (A) to next sprint to protect deals, and schedule (B) for Q2. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

elaine (Sales): +1 for (A) asap. We can re-run three named deals if parity-lite is in beta by end of sprint.

alex (Eng): pragmatic approach: (A) scope = UI toggle, server-side shim that maps toggle to existing routing policies, and emit route tag. We can do an internal beta in 3 weeks with one on-call engineer. Risk: edge cases when policies conflict.

mohit (Product Ops): can we make (A) opt-in via a feature flag so we can roll back quickly? release-bot: start canary plan?

release-bot: deploy-plan posted: canary=10% -> 30% -> 100% with 24h hold between steps. Tags: feature=parity-lite, owner=alex (Eng).

sarah (PM): ok action items: 1) alex + nate + kim: create a minimal spec today (include validation rules + telemetry events). 2) mohit: enable flag gating + beta cohort. 3) elaine: identify top 3 deals to invite to beta. 4) oliver: update support playbook for toggle rollback.

oliver (CS): will draft rollback steps and canned responses.

alex (Eng): will ping when spec PR is up. If we need scope shave beyond server-side shim, call it out quickly.

nate (Design): i'll post quick mocks in #design in the next 48h. Keeping it lean.

kim (Data): once tags exist i can start the dashboards and a quick alert for latency regressions.

sarah (PM): long term: we still want the recommendation engine (B) — that is our differentiator. But we can't cede parity in the market. We'll backfill B into Q2 roadmap. Thanks team, moving to exec sync to align GTM. :rocket:
